entities.name: Our Lady of Peace Cathedral, Baja California Sur
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Our Lady of Peace Cathedral or La Paz Cathedral is a Catholic church in the center of the city of La Paz, Baja California Sur, western Mexico that is the seat of the Diocese of La Paz. It is located where the mission was founded by the Jesuits in the eighteenth century.
